text:
Amira Khan: Quick heads-up  partner asked for a late-add guest quote from their CTO. They want it included in the blog and press advisory. Is that allowable under our embargo rules?

Ben Torres: Hmm, partner quotes are allowed but need Legal sign-off and exec approval. When would we need it by?

Amira Khan: They sent it now. They're requesting inclusion before the embargo lifts at 11:00 PT. We have ~90m.

Grace Li: That's tight. Legal often asks for context edits. @Derek Owens can you ping Legal? Also will need to update the press kit and the social copy.

Derek Owens: On it. Looping Legal (@PressOps Bot can ping Legal). Also confirm whether partner quote will change any comparative claims.

PressOps Bot: Notifying Legal channel and creating a review ticket: https://go.redwood/reviews/quote-2026-07-28. ETA for Legal look: 40m.

Ben Torres: Social note: if quote approved, we may need to delay primary tweet by +10m to incorporate. SocialBot, can you hold scheduled posts?

SocialBot: Holding scheduled posts: primary tweet at 11:05 PT paused. Will resume on confirm. :white_check_mark:

Grace Li: Also we should confirm partner's embargo compliance. Do they understand they can't publish early?

Amira Khan: Yes they confirmed. They also asked for a short bio blurb to accompany the quote. Sending that in DM.

Derek Owens: Legal update: they approved the quote with one edit (remove vendor comparison). Cleared at 10:18 PT. Addendum: include the standard disclaimer about test conditions.

Ben Torres: Great. I'll update the press advisory and the tweet thread. New schedule: tweet at 11:15 PT, LinkedIn long form at 11:25 PT. SocialBot keep ready.

PressOps Bot: Press kit updated with partner quote and bio. CDN purge scheduled at lift. Outreach list to be resent with "updated assets" subject line.

Grace Li: Ops confirm livestream link will still be good if we shift a few minutes? We may be +5 on exec intro.

Amira Khan: Ops said live link fine up to +15m shift.

Derek Owens: Final checklist: Legal cleared, press kit updated, social schedule adjusted, partner embargo confirmed. Anyone object?

Ben Torres: No objections. I'll monitor journalists. If anyone tries to pick up early, route them to me.

Amira Khan: Thanks team. One more ask: add a short note to the blog top explaining partner contribution so readers see it's labeled as partner commentary. Keep it neutral.

PressOps Bot: Reminder set: final go/no-go at 10:50 PT. Outreach send scheduled at 11:00 PT with updated assets.
